name: asc-release-flow
title_zh: 从 staging 到审核只按一次确认的发布编排器
tagline_zh: 版本暂存、构建上传、发布送审一条龙。Game Center 项目单独备好，卡住的提交和重试决策自动分流给健康检查。
tagline_en: Stage, upload, publish, submit in one flow. Game Center items prepped separately; stuck submissions and retry.
desc_en: Orchestrate App Store releases with asc, including staging a version, uploading or building an artifact, publishing, and submitting for review. Use when the user wants to prepare or execute a release. Keep Game Center item preparation in this skill; route other readiness failures, stuck submissions, cancellation, and retry decisions to asc-submission-health.
why_zh: 把发布拆成可确认的步骤，每步状态透明；失败不瞎猜，直接交给专门的健康检查技能判断。
why_en: Breaks release into confirmable steps with clear state; on failure, hands off to the dedicated health skill instead of piling.
limit_zh: 只认 asc 工具链；需要你本机已配置 App Store Connect API 密钥。
limit_en: Requires asc CLI and configured App Store Connect API keys. Handles submission only—not appeal or metadata fixes after rejection. Building needs an.
title_en: One-confirmation release orchestrator from staging to review
